text_block_list.name: Nearby Passersby
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's all this? A fight?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...I only meant to tell them they dropped 
their handkerchief, but—)

Her good intentions had backfired, leaving 
Symboli Kris S a little disheartened—
